text_block_list.text:
"—Noodle Calendar Year XXX.
The fiery Ramen Umamusume have finally
arrived at the supreme, ultimate bowl!"

text_block_list.name: Ramen Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah! The savory aroma of soy sauce is irresistible! It goes so well with the rich tonkotsu broth♪

text_block_list.name: Ramen Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
It's so...! It's so delicious!
The flavor is rich, tasty, and has a great punch of garlic!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
—Cut! Hmmm...
Top Road-san, if you could give a slightly more natural food review, that would be great...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry...!
Please let me try one more time!

On this day, Narita Top Road and
Fine Motion were shooting a commercial
for cup noodles.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I memorized the entire script, but...
the ad-lib parts are really difficult.

Due to her serious nature, Narita Top Road seems
to be struggling when asked for flexible reactions...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: The next scene is... the drama part, 'Fierce Battle in Ramen World'!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"What in the world is this 'Tonkotsu Sacred Sword'!?
Pulling it from the rock saves the kingdom...???"
choice_data_list: True, it really is hard to tell...
True, it's hard to make sense of it, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I haven't the foggiest idea either...
but isn't this the kind of thing where you're supposed to "Don't think, feel!"?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but still...
I'd like to understand as best I can.
Would it be correct to interpret it as 'firepower is the key'...?

The commercial's concept seems totally ridiculous.
At this rate, won't she struggle again?
Just as I was worrying...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I...
I'll go ask the director real quick!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Director! May I ask a question?
Does the scene with the Tonkotsu Sacred Sword connect to this line here?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you noticed? That was supposed to be hidden lore, so I'm surprised.
Though it was meant for only those who catch on...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see...! So this scene represents determination, then?
What mindset should I be acting with for the final scene—

text_block_list.name: Ramen Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Bow your heads!
Can you not see this noodle strainer?!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—All done♪
How does it look, Director?

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm...
This scene really needs some passion...
Huh...? Where's Top Road...?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"Behold the top student's
high-speed noodle straining!
Allow me to show you!"

text_block_list.name: Ramen Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Amazing, you're really in character!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Oho...! Fascinating! This is it!
A passion for ramen so fierce, you'd bet your life on it!
Splendid, to have taken it this far...!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Inspiration is welling up inside me! All right!
Let's give her more action scenes!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you serious, Director!?
Even so, springing it on them so suddenly, the cast won't be...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I can do it!
I'll give it my all to bring the world
the director envisioned to life!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san! You'd really say that for me...?! All right, let's do this!

And so, out of nowhere,
an action scene was added for Narita Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Committee Chair
text_block_list.text: Taaah! Tei! Meeeen!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Looking good! Bring more heat!
Shout your line right here!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"Savory pork back fat~!
Extra extra green onions~~~!
Chock-full of toppings perfect attendance award~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
"Make it sound more like an order!
The Ramen Committee Chairperson moves with snap and precision!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, Coach!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"SAVORY PORK BACK FAT—!!
EXTRA EXTRA GREEN ONIONS—!!!
CHOCK-FULL OF TOPPINGS PERFECT ATTENDANCE AWARD—!!!!!"
"...It's a world beyond my understanding, but watching them sink their teeth into it with everything they had was fascinating. Looks like my worries were completely unfounded...!"

text_block_list.name: Ramen Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
“—I want everyone to taste this flavor!
Take thiiiisss!!!”

—And so, the commercial aired to the world.
As soon as it played on TV and the internet, it immediately...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't Top Road and the others' commercial way too hilarious?!
It makes zero sense, but they're so dead serious about it~!
I ended up buying a whole box of those cup noodles!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san's scene was very well-received! I learned a lot from that shoot, too... Your earnest approach to everything is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's all thanks to everyone else!
I was just following
the director's instructions...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My all, huh... My absolute best...
Was it really that amusing?

When I told her that tackling it with dead seriousness
ended up coming full circle to look cool, she seemed pleased.
At any rate...!
choice_data_list: You really lived up to expectations.
You really lived up to expectations, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's true!
After all, this commercial is meant to make everyone laugh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There was no need to worry after all.
I'm so glad my best effort was a hit!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Really!
That means the commercial was a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I received a whole bunch of those cup noodles!
Please, let's eat them together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Ehehe... I really was totally wiped out after the photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "I want to be able to hold my head high and say... I gave it my absolute all! Hehehe!"
